column1: # NONE means no on-demand skill should be invoked; the concern is always-on or outside these domains.
# require lists primary skills that must fire. Related skills may co-fire without counting as over-invocation.
# A required primary invocation passes; a miss fails. NONE fails if any on-demand skill fires.

column4: Plan a React component that displays an order list fetched from an API.
Implement a hover tooltip on an icon in a React navbar, covering interaction and accessibility.
Add a submit button to a React form that disables while submitting and displays errors.
Design a new landing page for an analogue instrument studio with a visual identity unlike a generic SaaS template.
Refine spacing, typography, and visual hierarchy on an existing settings page for easier scanning without changing flow or brand.
The existing account page is unattractive. Propose a modern design with character, without implementing it yet.
Add a save microinteraction and an opening or closing panel transition without disrupting keyboard users.
Change semantic color tokens and typography scales shared across the product and verify contrast.
Add Arabic translations to a form, including pluralization, locale formatting, long text, and RTL.
For a settings page using decorative emoji, propose icons from the existing library while preserving accessible labels.
Design an orders table schema and indexes in PostgreSQL.
Add a cache layer to a frequently read query with invalidation.
Build an idempotent message-queue consumer that processes orders.
Transfer credit between two accounts correctly under concurrent requests and emit an event after commit.
Design retention and deletion for customer data across cache, search indexes, and audit trails.
Design a REST API contract for a users resource, including methods, status codes, and response envelope.
Define a consistent API error-response shape that is machine-readable and human-readable.
Start a backend service from scratch. Select maintainable runtime, framework, and database versions, then plan a minimum vertical slice.
Create a new web-application repository with no existing stack or architecture decisions. Establish the foundation before scaffolding.
Start a service using Node.js, Fastify, and PostgreSQL. Verify official LTS, support, and EOL information and select currently compatible version lines before planning.
Write a Node.js function that parses CSV into an array of objects.
Modify a `formatDate` utility used by several components to display dates.
